Riverside Market Welcomes New Vendors

LANGFORD (May 5)—The Riverside Farmers' Market, held every Saturday from May through October, will feature eight new vendors this season. Among them are a bakery specializing in whole-grain breads, a beekeeper selling honey and candles, and a couple who grow more than twenty varieties of tomatoes.

Market manager Delphine Osei said the market received a record number of applications this year. "We had space for only eight new stands, so the selection process was very competitive," she said.

The market will also introduce a "Kids' Corner" with cooking demonstrations for children on the first Saturday of each month. In addition, shoppers who bring their own bags will receive a token worth $1 that can be used at any stand.

--- Text 2 ---

To: Delphine Osei <dosei@riversidemarket.example>
From: Callum Reyes <callum@reyesbeefarm.example>
Date: June 9
Subject: Stand location

Dear Ms. Osei,

Thank you for including my farm in this year's market. Sales of my honey have been better than I expected, and customers have been very friendly.

I am writing because my stand is currently located at the end of the row next to the Kids' Corner. On the days when the cooking demonstrations take place, the area becomes very crowded, and it is difficult for customers to reach my table. Would it be possible to move my stand to another spot, at least on those days?

Thank you for considering my request.

Callum Reyes
question: What is the purpose of the article?
choices: To announce the closing of a market
To describe changes at a local market
To explain how vendors can apply for a stand next year
answer: To describe changes at a local market
explanation: 新しい出店者、子ども向けコーナー、エコバッグの特典など、今季の変化を紹介している。

Sincerely,
Leticia Monroe
